about.title: About me
paragraphs: I have been working full time with the web platform since 2011.
I'm currently at {{enac}} @ {{epfl}}, supporting researchers throughout their data lifecycle — from acquisition pipelines to custom visualisation interfaces.
Before that, I helped scale {{prevision}}'s AI platform and ship their machine-learning tooling.
Earlier, I was lead dev at {{numberly}}, shaping their ad-tech products as a dev-ops / full-stack developer.

cv.title: Curriculum Vitae
paragraphs: Studied Biology and Modelisation at Paris VI between 2011 and 2013, working part-time at the {{memory_foundation}}.
